Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game. The South Africans have cruised to victory and taken a 1-0 lead. They now have a chance to seal the series in the next game which will be played on the 9th of November at 1.50 PM local (3.20 AM GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye.

DALE STEYN HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. Is first of all, relieved that he has been able to finish a match in Australia without breaking down. Says that the bowlers were excited to get the first use of the wicket and even though there were runs to be scored on this pitch, if the balls were pitched in the right areas, you could get wickets. Does not believe that the wickets he got were his best balls and notes that Head and Short played straight and hence got out. Observes that Carey played square, hence got the runs. So that was the small difference. Is happy to keep the Australian batsmen quiet as he reckons that they are bullies in domestic cricket. On the camaraderie with his bowling mates, Steyn says that he always challenges them to try and take the next wicket first.

Victorious South African skipper Faf du Plessis is very happy with the team's display. Is even happier to have Dale Steyn back but is proud of the way all his three seamers bowled. On Hendricks' batting, Faf says that on surfaces like these, where the bounce is tricky, he batted like an experienced individual. Is happy to have taken a couple of good catches. On the overall display, he feels that towards the end, the Proteas let it slip a bit, as they could have won by 8 wickets but will take the win.

Australian captain, Aaron Finch admits that he is disappointed as the team did not play anywhere near its potential. Praises the South African bowling for putting the Aussies on the back foot early. On the message to his team, Aaron says that the loss is a great opportunity to learn and all they can do now is train harder, do the basics, pay a little bit of more attention to detail and come back fresh for the second ODI in Adelaide. Is harsh on his bowlers, clearly not happy with the way they gave away free runs. Dodges the question of not opening with Mitchell Starc. Hopes to come back hard in the next game.

Marcus Stoinis who is now giving for interview, says today was disappointing. Adds further they still have two games left and will look to bounce back. Reckons the wicket was a tough one to bat on. He believes the whole team together is responsible for this loss. He feels good to take the wickets he did. Ends by saying the coach will have a chat with the team and they hope to recover and come out fighting in the next game.

Quinton de Kock who is up for an interview, says the start with the ball and the bat was very crucial. Mentions he is disappointed with how he got out as he feels he could have been there till the end. Reckons Australia will surely come out fighting in the next game and they can't be taken lightly. Credits the way Rabada bowled.

Defending a paltry total, Australia needed wickets early but that was not the case. Their bowlers could not repeat the heroics of their opposition bowlers. They bowled well in patches but there were quite a few poor deliveries too. Pat Cummins did impress but he was unlucky. Stoinis had a three-fer to his name but by then, the game was probably done and dusted.

South Africa's batsman also did not disappoint as their openers did the bulk of the scoring. The two will be disappointed to miss out on half tons but their 94-run stand more-or-less sealed the deal. They did lose a couple of quick wickets in the end but by that time, it was probably too late.

How easy was that for South Africa? They have chased this total down without breaking a sweat. They looked like they were batting on completely different strip to that of the Australians. After bundling the hosts out for a very low total, with every bowler except for Rabada taking wickets. Steyn set the tone at the start and they never let the momentum slip after that. Andile Phehlukwayo was the one with the most wickets to his name as he finished with three. The rest, including, Rabada were equally impressive. It is them who set this up for their batters.

That is it! Miller finishes it off on his very first ball. Gets a gift to do so, on the pads, Miller flicks it through square leg and takes two. Customary handshakes taking place as SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 6 WICKETS!
David Miller is the new man in.

OUT! There goes another one! It though won't make a difference in the context of the game. But delight for Stoinis as he gets his third. Klaasen goes for the drive on the up, the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards Finch at first slip. He takes a very good catch.
Fuller around off, Klaasen guides it down to third man for another single. 2 needed.
Another three! Short and outside off, Faf cuts it through point and the batsmen run three.
On the middle stump, Faf tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Fullish on off, Faf strokes it towards mid off.
Good length again outside off, left alone.
A biggie away now! Driven on the up through covers for a couple.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Back of a length on off, Faf pushes it through covers for a run. Two boundaries away now.
Good bumper but Klaasen plays it well as he guides it down to third man.
Fullsih around off, the batsman drives it to point.
Heinrich Klaasen walks out to bat.

OUT! Drags it on! Markram does not stay there till the end. Stoinis gets his second. A poor shot. It was bowled short and wide outside off. Markram goes for the cut, way away from his body. Also no foot movement on that one. It takes the inside edge and it clips the leg pole.
Back of a length around off, Markram guides it towards the slip region. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
A bumper to end! Faf watches it go through to the keeper.
A yorker on off, it is jammed out towards point.
Length ball around off, Faf strokes it to covers.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
This is driven on the up through covers for a couple.
Back of a length around off, the batsman stands tall and keeps it out.
Mitchell Starc is back on.
FOUR! Up and over! 12 more needed now. On the pads, Markram flicks it over mid-wicket and the ball trickles away.
Good fielding! Fuller in length around off, it is stroked towards mid off. Cummins there dives to his left and makes a good stop. Can't stop the single though.
On middle, eased to mid on.
Good length again on off, it takes off after pitching. Faf defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Faf tries to punch it through covers but the ball goes off the inner half towards mid on.
Around the off pole, the batsman strokes it to mid off.
A dot as this is pushed to the man at covers.
Good length around off, Faf guides it towards backward point for an easy run. South Africa are in no rush to finish this quickly.
A little too straight again, Markram tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Angles it into the batter, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, it is pushed towards covers.
FOUR! Runs needed now below 20. Short and on the body, a rib-tickler. Markram goes for the pull but it goes off the gloves and fine down the leg side for a boundary.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.

IN THE AIR... BUT SAFE. A short ball, around middle, Aiden looks to pull but the bounce does him in. Takes the top edge which lands safely in front of square leg. By the time Mitchell Starc can get to the ball from fine leg, a couple taken.

MISFIELD, FOUR! Sloppy from Lynn. Sloppy from Australia. Talks about their mental state right now. On a length, around middle, Markram pushes it towards mid on. Chris Lynn gets across, attempts to stop the ball with a ginger tumble but does not even get his hands to the ball. It goes through and even manages to touch the ropes.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

ChuriTheKnife - This has been an awesome performance by South Africa. Do you think they can lift the World Cup this time? @ChuriTheKnife - Ummmm.... not too sure. They have played well but Australia have been sub-standard. Hard to keep SA as favourites with India and England in such good form.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, let through once more.
Full and outside off, coming in, watchfully defended.
On a length outside off, du Plessis shoulders arms.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
A length ball on middle, Markram flicks it through mid-wicket, falls and slips over but gets up and runs through for a single.
Skipper Faf du Plessis walks in at number 4, for the final rites of the game.

OUT! And now, Hendricks departs. Like de Kock, he too, misses out on his half century. A length ball, on middle and leg, Hendricks looks to work it to the leg side but the ball bounces from nowhere. Probably hit that spot on the pitch where the explosions have been taking place. As a result, the ball flies off the top portion of the bat towards mid on where Chris Lynn does the rest. Something for the Aussies to smile. Certainly Marcus Stoinis is pumped up.
Another one hits the batsman. Pitched on a length outside off, zipping back in, Reeza looks to flick but misses and is hit on the groin. He has taken a lot of blows today.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
On middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Marcus Stoinis introduced.
FOUR! Pulled with aplomb. A short ball, whipped over mid-wicket for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Another glorious shot! Full and outside off, Markram leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! CARESSED! Full and outside off, Markram leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
Hazlewood is back on.
On middle and off, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
A short ball, down the leg side, Markram looks to pull but the ball goes off his pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, punched through point. Glenn Maxwell just about stops it near the boundary. 3 runs taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

EDGED, BUT SAFE! This bloke has been the best of the Aussie bowlers. On a length outside off, Markram pushes at it but gets a healthy outside edge. It flies past the second slip fielder towards third man. Just a single.
Another nice shot but once again it is well fielded. Maxwell is the man again. This is driven square on the off side. Maxwell gives it chase and just about pulls it back in. Three taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length on off, kept out.
Nicely punched! Shorter in length around off, the batsman punches it through cover-point and the batsmen take another three. We have seen quite a few threes today. 100 up for South Africa.
A little fuller in length on middle, the batsman times it to mid off.
Back of a length on off, the batsman stands tall and blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
ChuriTheKnife - Hey! If that was not caught, shouldn't it be a wide? @ChuriTheKnife - I see that your observations are pretty sharp as your name...
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

NOT OUT. Nothing on the Snicko. A short ball, down the leg side, Markram looks to pull but misses. There is a noise as the ball passes the bat and Carey appeals. Umpire Aleem Dar thinks for a while and then raises his finger! Markram immediately takes the review and first we check the Hot Spot. Nothing. Then, the Snickometer. Nothing on it either. Move on. It is a wide as well.
Has that been caught behind? Umpire Aleem Dar thinks so. Not Markram. He has reviewed it.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple. Gets off the mark.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a length outside off, Markram feels for it but misses.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
DRINKS BREAK. Some respite for Australia. Though, they have only 58 runs more to defend. Can they pick up 3-4 more wickets? Here's Aiden Markram.

OUT! Stop the press. Australia have picked up a wicket. Full and outside off, probably a touch slower in pace. De Kock looks to go over the top but this time, gets more height than distance. Easy catch for Josh Hazlewood moving to his left from mid off. Misses out on a half century and also what would have been the first century opening stand for South Africa since October 2017.
FOUR! Terrific batting! De Kock is toying with the bowling. A length ball, down the leg side, Quinton just whips it over square leg and gets a boundary! 59 more needed to win now!

That is a sharp delivery, on a shorter length, Hendricks looks to sway out of the way but the ball hits his right shoulder and goes towards first slip. However, Aaron Finch fumbles and an alert de Kock calls his partner through for a single.
On a length outside off, too wide, punched straight to cover.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back for a second burst, after going for 16 in his opening over.
Fine delivery to end the over. On a length outside off, Hendricks looks to push at it but the ball bounces, takes the outside edge and then flies towards third man. A run taken.
On a length outside off, punched towards cover.
Good riposte from Cummins. He lands it on a length just outside off, RH stays back to defend but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge. Does not carry to Carey anyway.

FOUR! That is a nice shot. He has timed that well. After a bit of a struggle early on, Hendricks is now getting on with the scoring. Full and outside off, Reeza leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
On a length outside off, punched towards cover.
On middle and leg, flicked wide of mid on for a single. Just 69 more needed now.

FOUR! PUMMELED! 'Shot of the day! screams Mark Waugh on air. Sorry, says. Junior rarely screams. A short ball outside off, Hendricks dismisses it out of his presence and pulls it wide of mid on for a boundary. Moves to 33 from 53 balls with his third four. 10 from the over.
Terrific yorker, swinging in as well, but nicely dug out.
On middle and leg, pushed towards mid on for a quick run.

FOUR! Flashed and flashed hard! Fortune favours the brave. Any sort of width and de Kock pounces. This was short and outside off, plenty of width and Quinton just slashed it over first slip to the third man fence. That is his value for South Africa. Always comes at the opposition bowlers.
This is driven uppishly but lands just short of a diving point. A single taken.
Full and outside off, driven beautifully but straight to mid off.
Another push through the vacant cover region for another run.
Shortish around middle, de Kock half-pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length around off, the batsman punches it through cover-point. Three taken.
A brute of a bouncer that! Reeza ducks under it at the very end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The physio is out with the magic spray and like most of the times. It has done its job.
Ferocious delivery! Just like quite a few deliveries today, this one takes off after pitching on a length. Reeza tries to defend but misses and the ball hits him around the shoulder. He is in pain.
Too close to play that shot. Back of a length outside off, de Kock tries to cut but there is not enough room to play that shot. 85 more needed.
Misfield and runs, three of them. Full and around off, Reeza times it towards short covers. The fielder misfields and three taken.
On the shorter side and on the body, de Kock nudges it around the corner for a run.
A yorker outside off, Hendricks tries to jam it out but fails to do so. Carey fails to collect it and a bye is taken.
Around middle, it is kept out.
A bumper on middle, de Kock is hurried into the pull. He tries to pull out but the ball hits the bat and rolls towards mid-wicket for a run.
OUCH! That must have hurt! On middle and angling into the batsman. Hendricks tries to work it on the leg side but is hit on the thigh.
Around off, the batsman keeps it out.
Length again around middle, Hendricks pushes it towards mid off.
Another bumper and the batsman evades it.
Lovely bowling! On a length around off, Hendricks tries to defend but is beaten. The ball straightens a touch.
Back of a length on off, the batsman keeps it out off the back foot.
A yorker on middle, Reeza jams it out towards backward point for a run.
In the air but in the gap! Shortish outside off, Reeza punches it through covers for a couple.
Well bowled and well played! Short and at the body of the batsman. Keeps rising on him. RZ plays it by taking one hand off the handle and hence it dies onto the ground.
WIDE! The sucker ball way outside off, Hendricks goes after it but misses.
Shorter on off, RH pushes it to mid off.
Good fielding! Short and outside off, de Kock cuts it towards cover-point. Travis Head there dives to his right, makes a stop and also has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Drive and a miss! Similar ball to the one Short got out to. Full and outside off at good pace. Luckily for de Kock though it does not take his edge.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Not sure if the game would last till then. Also, change of ends for Mitchell Starc.

BEAUTY! Does not bowl it short. Instead he goes length around off, this one also shapes away. Hendricks is deep inside his crease expecting the short one. He tries to defend it by staying within his crease and gets beaten.
A short leg now coming in place. Time for some short stuff?
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket. This is turning out to be another good over for Australia.
Once again some extra bounce! on a length around off, it shoots off the surface. Reeza tries to block but the ball takes the inside edge and hits him near the box.
On a length around off, Hendricks gets behind the line and defends it.
Angles it into the batsman, RH flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length around off, kept out.
Pat Cummins is on. He needs to provide the breakthrough.
A dot to end! So a tight over here by Josh. Australia need to bowl a few more of these if they are to build pressure. Back of a length around off, defended towards point.
On the pads, flicked towards square leg.
Good length around off, kept out.

Good bowling! We saw Maxwell cop a blow in the first innings to a similar delivery. De Kock though played it better here. It was on a length and around off, it takes off after pitching. De Kock loosens his grip and plays it down onto the ground.
Angles this into the pads, de Kock misses the flick and gets hit high on the thigh pad.
Shortish and outside off, de Kock guides it through point and takes two.

FOUR! A boundary to end the over! Runs needed below 100 now. Full again on off, Reeza caresses it through covers and the ball wins the race against the mid off fielder. The run flow has continued after the break.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! That went to the fence like a tracer bullet. 50 up for South Africa and they are cruising along at the moment. Not such a bad delivery, just ahead of a length around off, Hendricks strokes it on the up through covers and you need not run for those. South Africa look like they are batting on a different strip altogether.
Length again outside off, the batsman does not play at it. South Africa can take their own time here.
Well bowled! Back of a length and cramping the batsman for room. Reeza defends it onto the ground.
Good length around off, kept out.
A single to end another good over! 11 from this one and 19 from the two after the break. On a length around off, RH tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards square leg for a single.

Make that 107. Excellent running once again. It is on the pads, de Kock again flicks it through mid-wicket. They run two and then see an opportunity for the third, go for it and complete it with ease.
FOUR! Picks it up with ease! Yes, it is a bad ball but it still has to be put away. On the pads, de Kock flicks it over square leg for a boundary. 110 more needed.
Slightly fuller again around off, the batsman pushes it to mid off.
A muted appeal but not given! On a length, pitched outside leg. De Kock tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Another three to begin this over. Fuller again around off, looking for some swing but there ain't any. RH times it through covers and runs three.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.

Good fielding! Desperate stuff! Full and around off, Reeza drives it square on the off side. Maxwell gives it a chase. He does not give up and right at the end, he flicks it back in. Saves a run. So a good first over after the break for South Africa, 8 from it.
Good running! De Kock strokes it towards wide mid off for a quick run.

A huge shout but not given! On the pads, de Kock goes for the flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but not given. Finch thinks about a review but Starc is not interested and rightly so as it is slipping down leg,
A little too straight from Starc, QdK flicks it through square leg and takes two. Once again, he is just using the pace of Starc.
Shortens his length but the line is outside off, left alone.
A positive start by de Kock. He pushes this full delivery through covers and bags a brace.

We are back after the break! Australians are seen in a huddle and now Finch leads them out. Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks follow and they will resume their innings. Mitchell Starc will start the proceedings for Australia. Here we go...

South Africa's quick start means that they need another 125 to win. That could be JUST 125 or STILL 125, depending on how confident are the Aussies in defending this total. JOIN US BACK AT 3.35 pm local (0735 GMT).

Another superb passage of play for the Proteas. The Australians will be deflated there. They would have been hoping for a wicket at least but the bowling was not at its best. Probably the case of trying too hard to pick up wickets?
Outside off, punched towards mid off. THAT WILL BE LUNCH!
Full and outside off, driven on the up, straight to point.
Outside off, inviting to drive, but guess it will be food first, so Hendricks lets it go. Lunch is just 2 balls away.
A sharp bouncer around off, Hendricks sways away from the line.
Outside off, let through again.
Full and outside off, left alone.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Outside off, Reeza tries to defend but the ball runs off the outside edge towards third man. A run taken.
IN THE AIR... BUT SAFE! There is that length - just between short and full. Outside off, Hendricks looks to push but the ball shoots up and goes off the edge, but over point. A couple taken.
One more leave outside off.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Outside off, punched from the back foot.
Mitchell Starc is on now.
Outside off, left alone.
Outside off, in the corridor of uncertainty, Quinton feels for it but misses.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

EDGED, BUT DOES NOT CARRY! Finally Hazlewood gets it in the right channel. Bowls it on a length outside off, Quinton gets forward to defend but an outside edge is induced which lands short of second slip.
FOUR! Badly lined this time. Down the leg side, de Kock just directs it to the fine leg fence. 128 more to win now.
FOUR! BRILLIANT! The boundary flow continues. Third of the innings already. Half volley outside off, de Kock drives this through the covers and gets a boundary.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover. 16 from the over! What a start from the Proteas.
FIVE WIDES! Sloppy from Coulter-Nile. Full and down the leg side, Hendricks misses his flick and Carey cannot stop it cleanly, even with a dive. Parries it to the fine leg fence.
Short and outside off, QdK cuts it hard and almost gets the third boundary of the over. But Glenn Maxwell throws himself to his right and parries it to third man. Just a single.

FOUR! BEAUTY! Not the best bit of bowling from Coulter-Nile. He floats up a half volley, outside off, de Kock gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it wide of mid off for the second boundary of the over. Quinton moves to 10 from 6 balls.
Down the leg side, flicked beautifully behind square leg for a couple.
FOUR! De Kock is away. Full and swinging in, Quinton flicks it wide of a diving mid on and gets the first boundary of the run chase. 148 more needed to win.
Full and around off, swinging in, pushed towards mid on.
Nathan Coulter-Nile to bowl with the second new ball.
Landed outside off, right in the corridor of Josh, left alone.
On a length around off, extra bounce, Hendricks looks to tuck but the ball goes off the inside edge and hits him right on the box. Ouch.
That is a jaffa. On a length outside off, Reeza plays for the line but it moves away at the last moment and beats him.
Landed on a length outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, de Kock misses his flick and the ball goes off his thigh pads towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Full and around middle to start, watchfully defended.

The players are back out in the middle. Interesting. Josh Hazlewood will start off the proceedings. Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks will open the innings for South Africa. Quinton to face. Here we go...
